attribution_limitations: The abstract gives 30% body surface area and the case narrative gives over 30% for the November 2022 presentation. Do not pick one value.
Psoriasis is called moderate at original diagnosis and severe in the introduction; extensive in November 2022. The time of the severe wording is not stated.

Vitiligo is first described in November 2023. The November 2022 examination does not mention it, so its absence at baseline is not documented.
